simple.summary: בּוּל (bûwl) means produce (of the earth, etc.) First listed occurrence: Isa 44 19.

definitions.full: H944. bul II. בּוּל noun masculine product, produce , see יבול . בּוּל noun [masculine] produce, outgrowth (abbreviated or scribal error for foregoing) — only singular construct ׳ב הָרִים Job 40:20 ; also ׳ב עֵץ Isa 44:19 the produce of a tree , i.e. a block of wood.
